source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    seeds = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if out[r][c] == 0 and out[r][c - 1] != 0 and out[r][c - 1] == out[r][c + 1]:
                color = out[r][c - 1]
                out[r][c] = color
                seeds.append((r, c, color))
    for r, c, color in seeds:
        for rr in range(r - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[rr][c] != 0:
                break
            out[rr][c] = color
    return out
'''
